1586-2226-6751.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control tap for at least {2}{R}{G}{W} plus half the cost of your self-bouncing creature.
1586-2226-6751.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Cast Zacama either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {6}{R}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Zacama enters, its ability triggers twice through Starfield Vocalist.
Resolve the first Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Resolve the second Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Silver Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Silver Drake enters, its ability triggers twice, causing you to return itself and Zacama to your hand.
Repeat.

3755-4687-4929.notablePrerequisites: Cryptic Trilobite has at least four counters on it.
3755-4687-4929.description:
Activate Elven Chorus by tapping Gilder Bairn, adding one mana.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on Cryptic Trilobite.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite as many times as necessary by removing counters from it, adding at least two mana.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite counters on Cryptic Trilobite, you may instead double the counters on any other permanents.

225-1308-2557-4365-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers eight times
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a New Planet.
Repeat from step 3 for the remaining triggers.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

2866-3338-4096-6699--175.description:
Activate Goblin Welder by tapping it, causing you to sacrifice the artifact with mana value 0 and return Tooth of Ramos from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Scrap Trawler triggers, returning nothing to your hand.
Activate Tooth of Ramos by sacrificing it.
Scrap Trawler triggers, returning the artifact with mana value 0 from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Tooth of Ramos ability.
Cast the artifact with mana value 0 by paying {0}.
Mirran Spy triggers, untapping Goblin Welder.
Repeat.

215-3043-4785.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five creatures with defender.
215-3043-4785.description:
Activate Axebane Guardian by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Axebane Guardian from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Axebane Guardian by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

216-1636-7542.easyPrerequisites:
You control a creature that can tap to produce at least {U}.
You control two untapped creatures excluding the mana-producing creature and Harmonized Trio.
216-1636-7542.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Activate Harmonized Trio by tapping it and two other creatures you control, causing it to become prepared.
Cast a copy of Brainstorm by paying {U}.
Metallurgic Summonings triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Resolve Brainstorm, causing you to draw three cards and put two cards from your hand onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

6798-6972-7768.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Chaotic Goo.
When Chaotic Goo dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

1849-3259-7358.easyPrerequisites: You don't control a Devil token.
1849-3259-7358.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1849-3259-7358.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Maestros Diabolist as attackers.
Maestros Diabolist triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
If the sacrificed creature was a Devil token, it triggers when it dies, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat each combat phase.

1445-5477-7175.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one creature card in your hand.
You have at least one creature card in your graveyard.
1445-5477-7175.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning any other creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Insidious Roots triggers, creating a 0/1 Plant creature token, then putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control.
Activate the Plant by tapping it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

1563-3899-4927-6705.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to Ley Weaver with "Elf" chosen

1399-1606-2404-7040.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creatures.
1399-1606-2404-7040.description:
Activate Gaea's Cradle by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping Wirewood Lodge and Gaea's Cradle.
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Ley Weaver.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2438-4907-6972.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Tatterkite
When Tatterkite dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its static effect.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

3680-5299-5466.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Stunt Double
3680-5299-5466.description:
Cast Stunt Double by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Rakdos Joins Up.
Put Stunt Double into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Stunt Double's first ability and second ability trigger, along with Rakdos Joins Up's second ability.
Resolve Stunt Double's second trigger and Rakdos Joins Up's trigger, dealing damage to target opponent.
Resolve Stunt Double's first trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters on it as a copy of Rakdos Joins Up.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

3301-4222-6788.easyPrerequisites: You have an artifact card in hand with the mana to cast it, including at least one colored mana.
3301-4222-6788.description:
Animate Solar Array, if needed.
Cast Freed from the Real by paying its mana cost, attaching it to Solar Array.
Activate Solar Array by tapping it, adding {U} and causing the next artifact spell you cast this turn to have sunburst.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Solar Array.
Repeat from step 3 as desired.
Cast any artifact spell, triggering its sunburst ability an infinite number of times, either putting infinite +1/+1 counters on charge counters on the artifact.
3301-4222-6788.notes: This combo can be repeated whenever you want to cast an artifact spell. If needed as well, you can tap Solar Array for colored mana to use in casting that spell, assuming you do not want to continue the combo after the spell is cast.

1479-5478-5700-5701-6754.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-5478-5700-5701-6754.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Eusocial Engineering trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Eusocial Engineering trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield untapped as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Eusocial Engineering triggers.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Eusocial Engineering trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Eusocial Engineering triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

1308-1445-2366-4826-6413.easyPrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
1308-1445-2366-4826-6413.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding Dryad Arbor.
Green Goblin's second ability triggers, creating two untapped Treasure tokens due to Archelos.
Resolve the Tortured Existence ability, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card.
Green Goblin's first ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a Goblin you control.
Resolve the Tortured Existence ability, returning Dryad Arbor from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

618-2034-5887.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Werefox Bodyguard.
When the Werefox Bodyguard token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Werefox Bodyguard leaves the battlefield.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Werefox Bodyguard token, adding {C}{C}.
When the Werefox Bodyguard token dies, Kiki-Jiki is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat.

225-1170-2733-5921-5954.notablePrerequisites:
Fractured Realm is unlocked.
Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
225-1170-2733-5921-5954.description:
Cast Shimmering Wings by paying {U}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
When the Everywhere land tokens enter the battlefield, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers that many times.
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Holding priority, activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping an Everywhere token.
Repeat from step 5 for the remaining trigger.
Resolve the Shimmering Wings spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Shimmering Wings by paying {U}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1367-3039-4450-5362.description:
Cast Quantum Misalignment by paying {4}{U}, creating a nonlegendary copy of Carth the Lion and exiling Quantum Misalignment.
Cast Nexus of Fate by paying {5}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and shuffle Nexus of Fate into your library.
Activate Liliana Vess's second loyalty ability by removing zero loyalty counters from it, searching your library for Nexus of Fate, then shuffling your library and putting it on top.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, you may cast Quantum Misalignment from exile without paying its mana cost, targeting anything.
In your next draw step, draw Nexus of Fate.
Repeat from step 2, skipping step 4.

2416-4131-4893.notablePrerequisites: Basalt Monolith does not have summoning sickness.
2416-4131-4893.description:
Activate Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Cast Rise and Shine by paying {1}{U}, making Basalt Monolith a 0/0 artifact creature and putting four +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Basalt Monolith's last ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Activate Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Repeat from step 3.

85-4968.notablePrerequisites:
Deathbringer Thoctar has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Vorpal Sword attached to Deathbringer Thoctar.
85-4968.description:
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any creature an opponent controls.
The creature dies as a state-based action due to Deathbringer Thoctar's deathtouch.
Deathbringer Thoctar triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Repeat as desired.
You may also repeat this combo whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

185-1980-3098-4872.manaNeeded: {3}{U}{U} on each odd-numbered turn, with at most {3}{U} available each even-numbered turn
185-1980-3098-4872.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying {3}{U}{U}, targeting yourself.
Swarm Intelligence triggers, copying Time Warp, targeting yourself.
Resolve both Time Warps, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Move to your next turn.
Cast etiher Mystic Retrieval or Call to Mind by paying its mana cost, targeting either Call to Mind or Mystic Retrieval in your graveyard.
Swarm Intelligence triggers, copying Call to Mind or Mystic Retrieval, targeting Time Warp.
Resolve both Call to Minds or Mystic Retrievals, returning Time Warp and either Call to Mind or Mystic Retrieval from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Repeat.

2792-5140-5256.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{B}.
2792-5140-5256.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{B}.
Activate Kenrith's fifth ability by paying {4}{B}, returning Great Whale from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Great Whale enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Great Whale, causing target player to mill cards equal to Great Whale's power.
Repeat.
